labels.l1: service layer: provider and consumer, the interfaces left for you to implement
labels.l2: config layer: every framework needs to provide configuration files so that you can configure it
labels.l3: proxy layer: the proxy layer; for both consumer and provider, dubbo generates proxies for you, and the proxies communicate over the network
labels.l4: registry layer: a provider registers itself as a service, so a consumer can ask the service registry for the service it wants to call
labels.l5: cluster layer: a provider can be deployed on multiple machines, and multiple providers form a cluster
labels.l6: monitor layer: how many times has the consumer called the provider? Statistics and monitoring
labels.l7: protocol layer: handles the network communication when a concrete provider and consumer call an interface
